headword: {文書|ぶんしょ}{作成|さくせい}

definitions.gloss: document creation; document preparation; drafting documents
definitions.explanation: The act of writing, composing, or producing official or formal documents such as reports, contracts, proposals, and correspondence.

examples.japanese: {文書|ぶんしょ}{作成|さくせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: It took time to prepare the document.

examples.japanese: {文書|ぶんしょ}{作成|さくせい}⟦ソフト→ソフト：01532_sofuto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{報告書|ほうこくしょ}→報告書：06744_houkokusho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いた→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: I wrote the report using a word processing application.

examples.japanese: ⟦{契約書|けいやくしょ}→契約書：06416_keiyakusho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{文書|ぶんしょ}{作成|さくせい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{法務部|ほうむぶ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{担当|たんとう}→担当：02567_tantou⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The legal department handles the preparation of contracts.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{文書|ぶんしょ}→文書：12947_bunsho⟧ (document; written text) and ⟦{作成|さくせい}→作成：04186_sakusei⟧ (creation; preparation). A key term in office and administrative work. Can be used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ as a verb ({文書|ぶんしょ}{作成|さくせい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {文書|ぶんしょ}{作成|さくせい}⟦ソフト→ソフト：01532_sofuto⟧: word processing software
- {文書|ぶんしょ}{作成|さくせい}⟦{能力|のうりょく}→能力：03541_nouryoku⟧: document writing ability
- ⟦{公文書|こうぶんしょ}→公文書：11677_koubunsho⟧⟦{作成|さくせい}→作成：04186_sakusei⟧: preparation of official documents
- {文書|ぶんしょ}{作成|さくせい}⟦{業務|ぎょうむ}→業務：09630_gyoumu⟧: document preparation work

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{文章|ぶんしょう}→文章：02957_bunshou⟧⟦{作成|さくせい}→作成：04186_sakusei⟧: writing composition — broader, includes any written text, not just formal documents
- ⟦{起案|きあん}→起案：15569_kian⟧: drafting; proposal writing — more formal, specifically about creating initial drafts for approval
- ⟦{書類|しょるい}{作成|さくせい}→書類作成：18870_shoruisakusei⟧: paperwork preparation — similar but emphasizes the paper-based nature of the documents
